title: Employees' State Insurance – Medical Benefit Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Medical-care component of the ESI social-security system covering insured workers and eligible dependants through ESI healthcare facilities and tie-up services.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
